description: Slido Clone MVP - live polls, word clouds and moderated Q&A for audiences joining by code

userStories.title: Scaffold Next.js app with tooling
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a working app skeleton so that all later stories have a base.
acceptanceCriteria: Next.js (App Router) + TypeScript project in the repo root, with ESLint and Vitest configured; scripts: dev, build, lint, typecheck, test
Custom Node server (server.ts) hosts Next.js and attaches Socket.IO at /socket.io; `npm run dev` starts both on port 3000
Reads DATABASE_URL, TEST_DATABASE_URL, SESSION_SECRET, PARTICIPANT_TOKEN_SECRET from .env.local; commit a .env.example with the same keys and no values
Home page at / renders a placeholder; a smoke test passes
`npm run lint` and `npm run build` succeed
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Database layer and migrations
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a migration tool and DB client so that schema changes are repeatable.
acceptanceCriteria: Use Drizzle ORM + drizzle-kit (or an equivalent SQL migration tool) with the `pg` driver against DATABASE_URL
Scripts: db:migrate, db:migrate:test (runs against TEST_DATABASE_URL), db:reset:test
A test helper truncates tables between tests using TEST_DATABASE_URL
A trivial migration runs successfully on both databases
Document the commands in the root CLAUDE.md
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Users table
userStories.description: As a developer, I need host accounts stored so that hosts can log in.
acceptanceCriteria: `users` table: id, email (unique, lowercase), password_hash, role (only value 'admin'), active (default true), created_at
Migration runs successfully on both databases
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Auth API: sign up, log in, log out
userStories.description: As a host, I want to sign up and log in with email and password.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/auth/signup, /api/auth/login, /api/auth/logout; passwords hashed with argon2 or bcrypt
Sessions use a secure, httpOnly, sameSite cookie; GET /api/auth/me returns the current user or 401
Invalid credentials return 401 with a generic error message; duplicate email returns 409; inactive users cannot log in
A shared `requireAdmin` helper rejects requests without an active session with 401
Tests cover signup, login, logout, bad password, duplicate email, requireAdmin
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Shared rate limiter
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a reusable rate limiter so that endpoints can be protected.
acceptanceCriteria: `rateLimit(key, limit, windowSeconds)` utility with an in-memory store behind an interface (Redis is NOT installed in this environment; a Redis adapter can be added later)
Login is limited per IP and per email (e.g. 10 attempts / 15 minutes) and returns 429 when exceeded
Unit tests cover under-limit, over-limit and window reset
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Login and signup pages with dashboard guard
userStories.description: As a host, I want sign-up and login pages so that I can reach my dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: /signup and /login pages with email/password forms and visible error messages
/dashboard shows the user's email and a Log out button
Unauthenticated visits to /dashboard redirect to /login
Layout works at 360px width
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Events table and event API
userStories.description: As a host, I want to create and manage events through an API.
acceptanceCriteria: `events` table: id, owner_id (FK users, ON DELETE CASCADE), name (max 80), starts_at, ends_at, join_code (unique, 4-6 digits), moderation_mode ('open'|'moderated', default 'open'), created_at
POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/events (admin only); join code generated unique on create; GET lists events sorted by start date
Name is required and max 80 chars; ends_at cannot be before starts_at
Deleting an event cascades to every table that references it (add ON DELETE CASCADE to future event-owned tables)
Tests cover create, list order, rename, delete, validation, 401
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Event dashboard UI
userStories.description: As a host, I want to create, rename and delete events from the dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: 'New event' form with name, start and end date; on save the event shows its join code and join URL
Dashboard lists events sorted by start date
Host can rename an event and delete one after a confirmation dialog
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Participants table and join API
userStories.description: As a participant, I want to join an event by code without an account.
acceptanceCriteria: `participants` table: id, event_id (FK cascade), token_hash or token id, joined_at, nickname (nullable), first_response_at (nullable)
POST /api/join {code} returns the event and sets a signed anonymous participant token cookie; invalid code returns 404 'Event not found'
Re-joining with an existing valid token for the same event reuses the participant record
Join endpoint is rate limited per IP; no personal data is stored
Tests cover valid code, invalid code, token reuse, rate limit
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Join pages
userStories.description: As a participant, I want to enter a code on the home page or open a join link.
acceptanceCriteria: Home page has one code input and a Join button; invalid code shows 'Event not found'
/join/[code] joins directly and skips the code step
Participant view page /e/[eventId] shows the event name and a waiting state
Layout works at 360px width with tap targets of at least 44px
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Interaction base model
userStories.description: As a developer, I need one shared model for live interactions.
acceptanceCriteria: `interactions` table: id, event_id (FK cascade), type ('poll'|'wordcloud'), title, state ('draft'|'live'|'closed', default draft), position, config (jsonb), created_at
Partial unique index allows at most one 'live' interaction per event
Q&A is NOT an interaction (separate per-event stream)
Migration runs on both databases
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Poll API: create and manage drafts
userStories.description: As a host, I want to create and edit polls through an API.
acceptanceCriteria: POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/events/:id/interactions for type 'poll'; config holds options (2-10, each with id and label), multiSelect, showResultsToParticipants (default false)
Validation: question required, 2-10 options
Endpoints to reorder (update position), duplicate (copy in draft) and delete; only drafts can be edited or deleted
Only the event owner can use these endpoints (403/404 otherwise)
Tests cover validation, duplicate, reorder, edit-only-in-draft, ownership
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Poll builder UI
userStories.description: As a host, I want a form to build polls.
acceptanceCriteria: Event page lists the event's interactions with their state
Poll form: question, 2-10 options (add/remove), single/multi-select toggle, show-results-to-participants toggle
Host can edit, reorder, duplicate and delete draft polls from the list
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Realtime infrastructure
userStories.description: As a developer, I need realtime rooms so that state changes reach participants quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: Socket.IO rooms per event: participants join with their token, the host with their session; `publish(eventId, name, payload)` server helper behind an interface (in-memory now; Redis adapter later)
Client hook `useEventSocket(eventId)` with automatic reconnect and polling fallback
Unauthorized sockets cannot join host-only rooms
Integration test: two clients in one event receive a published message; a client in another event does not
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Start and close interactions
userStories.description: As a host, I want to start and close an interaction.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/interactions/:id/start sets state 'live' and closes any other live interaction in that event atomically; POST .../close sets 'closed'
Participants in the room receive a 'state-changed' event within 1 second
Starting a closed interaction is rejected unless explicitly reopened via a new draft copy
Host event page has Start and Close buttons showing the current state
Tests cover one-live-at-a-time and the socket broadcast
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Participant live view
userStories.description: As a participant, I want to see the live poll appear without refreshing.
acceptanceCriteria: Participant page shows the live interaction (poll options) in real time, 'Waiting for the host' when none is live, and 'Voting closed' when it closes
Loading the page mid-event shows the current live interaction
Single column layout, 360px width, 44px tap targets
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Vote API
userStories.description: As a participant, I want my vote recorded exactly once.
acceptanceCriteria: `poll_votes` table: id, interaction_id (FK cascade), participant_id (FK cascade), option_ids (jsonb), created_at, with UNIQUE(interaction_id, participant_id)
POST /api/interactions/:id/vote validates options belong to the poll, respects single/multi-select, rejects votes when the poll is not live (409) and second votes (409)
Sets participants.first_response_at on the first response
Vote endpoint is rate limited per participant token and per IP
Successful votes publish updated counts to the event room
Tests cover valid, duplicate, closed poll, invalid option, single-select with multiple options, rate limit
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Vote UI and confirmation
userStories.description: As a participant, I want to submit my vote and see confirmation.
acceptanceCriteria: Participant selects option(s) and taps Submit; a confirmation is shown afterwards and the form is locked
Results are shown to the participant only if the poll's showResultsToParticipants is true
Server errors (already voted, closed) show a clear message
Radio/checkbox controls have accessible labels and visible focus
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Presenter view with live results
userStories.description: As a host, I want a full-screen results view.
acceptanceCriteria: /present/[eventId] (admin only) shows the live question, a bar chart with count, percent and total votes, updating live without refresh
Bars use labels and values, not colour alone; large high-contrast type
Shows 'No live interaction' when none is live
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Presenter join code, QR and navigation
userStories.description: As a host, I want the room to join easily and to move between polls.
acceptanceCriteria: Join code and a QR code of the join URL are shown in a corner of the presenter view
Left/right arrow keys move to the previous/next interaction of the event (starting it and closing the current one)
Escape exits fullscreen; the page works in fullscreen
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Word cloud API
userStories.description: As a host, I want to create word cloud prompts and collect words.
acceptanceCriteria: Interaction type 'wordcloud' with config maxEntriesPerParticipant (1-5) and prompt; create/edit via the interaction endpoints
`wordcloud_entries` table (interaction_id, participant_id FK cascade, normalized_word, created_at)
POST /api/interactions/:id/words: trims, lowercases, max 25 chars, enforces per-participant limit, rejects when not live, rate limited
Profanity filter: blocked words are stored but flagged hidden and never returned in results
GET results returns merged counts of identical words; changes publish to the event room
Tests cover normalization, merge, limit, profanity, closed state
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Word cloud UI
userStories.description: As a host and participant, I want to build, answer and display word clouds.
acceptanceCriteria: Host form for word cloud prompts with max entries 1-5 in the interaction builder
Participant view: input to submit words with remaining-entries count and errors
Presenter view renders words sized by frequency, updating live (include a non-colour cue such as the count on hover/focus and an accessible text list)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Questions API (Q&A)
userStories.description: As a participant, I want to ask questions.
acceptanceCriteria: `questions` table: id, event_id (FK cascade), participant_id, text (max 300), author_name (nullable), status ('pending'|'approved'|'rejected'), answered (bool), pinned (bool), created_at
POST /api/events/:id/questions: anonymous by default, name only if provided, profanity filter, rate limit 5 per participant per minute
In 'moderated' mode new questions are 'pending'; in 'open' mode they are 'approved'
GET for participants returns only approved questions (never pending or rejected)
Tests cover moderated/open modes, rate limit, never exposing pending questions
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Q&A participant UI
userStories.description: As a participant, I want a Q&A tab to ask questions.
acceptanceCriteria: Q&A tab with a text box (max 300 chars with counter) and optional name field
In moderated mode shows 'Your question is waiting for approval' after submit
Approved questions list appears and updates live
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Upvote questions
userStories.description: As a participant, I want to upvote questions.

Question list returns vote counts; sortable by Popular and Recent in the UI; counts update live
Participants cannot vote on pending/rejected questions; endpoint rate limited

userStories.title: Presence and engagement metrics
